jobs.job_description: We are seeking a .NET developer with strong C# and ASP.NET Core experience, REST APIs, and clean architecture skills. Experience with SQL, Docker, and cloud deployment is valued.
We need a full-stack engineer with React, TypeScript, REST APIs, and backend service design experience. Strong collaboration and software quality focus expected.
We are building AI-powered applications with prompting, RAG, and agent frameworks. Experience with evaluation, retrieval, and LLM-based application design is important.
Vi søger en backendudvikler til at bygge robuste APIs, arbejde med clean architecture og Docker, og samarbejde tæt med produkt- og frontendteams.
We are hiring a junior software developer interested in learning backend engineering, C#, and modern development practices while contributing to a collaborative team.
We are looking for a platform engineer with Kubernetes, Azure, and distributed systems experience. Strong operational ownership and cloud deployment background is required.
We are looking for a developer with healthcare domain understanding, API workflows, and clean architecture experience. Prior work with healthcare interoperability or system integration is a plus.
